title: System (Presales) Engineer, France - Large Public Sector
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The role

You will be the Technical Partner of our Account Executives in our France Public Sector district, helping large and strategic public sector organizations make strategic technical decisions. You own the technical win: from first discovery conversation to solution design, proof of concept and closure. You move comfortably between a CIO, CDO or senior public sector leadership conversation and a hands-on architecture review on the same day.

This is a brand new position: we are growing! Our SE team in France is expanding, and as we add Systems Engineers we move closer to one Systems Engineer for every Account Executive. Collaboration is part of how the team works.

What you will do

  • Understand customer business drivers and data strategy, and translate them into clear, future-ready architectures on the Everpure platform.
  • Lead the technical side of complex sales cycles: discovery, solution design, demos, proofs of concept, benchmarks and competitive evaluations.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to executives and to hands-on technical teams.
  • Partner closely with your Account Executive and with channel and ecosystem partners on strategic opportunities.
  • Write and own the technical content of RFP and RFI responses.
  • Share what you learn with the team: mentor peers, share best practice and help colleagues win.
  • Represent Everpure at customer events, executive briefings and industry forums.

What you bring (must have)

  • 8+ years of field pre-sales experience (Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) supporting large, complex customers.
  • Experience supporting large and strategic public sector accounts, or comparable large, complex organizations.
  • Strong enterprise data management knowledge: data platforms, data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, analytics and AI/ML data pipelines, data protection and governance.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure (compute, networking, virtualization, security), enough to be credible with infrastructure teams.
  • Comfort with cloud and cloud-native technologies (containers, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP, hybrid integration).
  • Business fluent in French and English, able to explain complex architectures clearly in both.
  • A team-first mindset, with a track record of helping colleagues succeed.
  • Able to work from our Paris office and to travel occasionally within France and EMEA.

Nice to have

  • Enterprise storage experience (SAN, NAS, object, NVMe-oF). Not required: we will train you.
  • Background at a modern data platform vendor, a data protection vendor or a systems integrator.
  • Exposure to regulated, high-security or high-compliance environments, and familiarity with public procurement.
  • Existing relationships in the French public sector.


What this role is not

  • It is not a support or post-sales role. You work before the customer buys, on strategic opportunities.
  • It is not an Account Executive role. Your Account Executive owns the commercial relationship, and you own the technical outcome.
  • It is not a role for a single narrow vertical: you will cover large and strategic public sector accounts as a generalist.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
